technical_overview: Offered at $24.0 for 6ml, this KoColor Fashion CONCEALER is expertly formulated with Water, Caprylyl Methicone, Iron Oxides, Red 40 Lake. Delivering a high-fidelity Terracotta Sunset (Deep-Warm) color profile (`#E2725B`), it leverages advanced engineering via high-purity pigments and volatile carriers. For optimal chromatic impact, apply directly to a clean, prepped surface.
